entities.summary: Gyeongju Seop clan is one of the Korean clans. Their Bon-gwan is in Gyeongju, North Gyeongsang Province. According to the research held in 2000, the number of Gyeongju Seop clan's member was 285. Their founder was Seop Gong je who worked as a Counsellor Remonstrant and Hanlin Academy in Song dynasty. Seop Gong je exiled himself to Goryeo expecting confliction and was settled in Damyang County located in Jeolla Province. Then, Gojong of Goryeo gave a government post to Seop Gong je. Seop Gong je retired his active life in Gangneung located in Gangwon Province (historical) via Gyeongju in Gyeongsang Province because enemies in Yuan dynasty came near him.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: The Gyeongju Seop clan played a significant regional role in Korean history, with their founder Seop Gong je receiving government posts and settling in key locations such as Gyeongju and Gangneung. Although not world-changing, they contributed to the social and political landscape of Korea during the Song and Goryeo dynasties.
